fact: In April 2026 the director general of State Domains urged full use of the Amlak information system across state property, cadastre and land conservation, and a pilot of model sites issuing cadastral and land-conservation extracts through the national digital portal began at the Dar El Beida and El Harrach conservations.
title: Recettes record et services numériques : l'État modernise la gestion foncière
